issues.title: STU-1: Add server-side student paging, search and filters
issues.body:
## Goal
Make the full student list reachable and easy to navigate.

## Work
- Add server-side pagination and search.
- Filter by class, route and student status.
- Preserve page and filters when returning from student details.
- Enforce role scoping in API queries.

## Done when
- All authorized students are reachable; the list is not capped at 100.
- Search and filters run server-side.
- Returning preserves list position and filters.

## Dependencies
- SEC-2 role-scoped student data.

## Size
M

issues.title: STU-2: Build a phone-first student list
issues.body:
## Goal
Make everyday student lookup fast on small screens.

## Work
- Use student cards on phone layouts.
- Show name, class, roll and route.
- Add a guardian-call action only where permitted.
- Open student details on card selection.
- Ensure touch targets are at least 44px.

## Done when
- Works at 360px in light and dark themes.
- Cards show only role-authorized fields.
- Interactive controls have 44px touch targets.

## Dependencies
- SEC-2 role-scoped student data.

## Size
M

issues.title: STU-3: Add role-aware student detail tabs
issues.body:
## Goal
Provide a student detail page with permission-aware tabs.

## Work
- Add Profile, Attendance, Marks, Fees and Transport tabs.
- Hide tabs the role cannot access.
- Enforce permissions in APIs, not only the UI.
- Add loading, empty and error states.

## Done when
- Teachers cannot access Fees.
- Clerks cannot access Marks.
- API tests prove unauthorized data cannot be retrieved.

## Dependencies
- SEC-2 role-scoped student data.
- SEC-3 fee-data restrictions.

## Size
L

issues.title: STU-4: Improve student add and edit forms
issues.body:
## Goal
Make student data entry clearer and reduce invalid records.

## Work
- Group related fields.
- Choose class, section and route from existing records.
- Validate mobile numbers using the school's approved format.
- Show clear save, validation and error messages.
- Avoid silently overwriting existing records.

## Done when
- Class and route values come from valid lists.
- Invalid mobile input is explained.
- Save success/failure is visible.
- Existing records change only when explicitly edited.

## Size
M

issues.title: STU-5: Add bulk class and section assignment
issues.body:
## Goal
Allow authorized staff to assign multiple students efficiently.

## Work
- List students without a class.
- Select multiple students and assign class and section.
- Preview the selection before saving.
- Validate target class and section.
- Record assignment actions for auditability.

## Done when
- Authorized staff can assign multiple students in one operation.
- Unassigned students are clearly listed.
- Invalid assignments are rejected and successful changes confirmed.

## Dependencies
- SEC-2 role-scoped student data.

## Size
M

issues.title: STU-6: Replace student delete with left-school workflow
issues.body:
## Goal
Prevent accidental hard deletion and use a controlled student-leaving workflow.

## Work
- Replace the ordinary Delete action with Mark as left school.
- Show a confirmation naming the selected student.
- Hide left-school students from normal active lists while retaining authorized history.
- Restrict eventual hard deletion to the approved retention process.

## Done when
- Normal UI workflows cannot hard-delete a student.
- Marking a student as left school requires explicit confirmation.
- The action is recorded in the audit trail.

## Dependencies
- PRV-4 retention and left-school status.

## Size
S

issues.title: STU-7: Mask sensitive student fields by default
issues.body:
## Goal
Reduce unnecessary exposure of student and guardian contact details.

## Work
- Mask mobile numbers by default, showing only the last four digits.
- Provide a reveal action only to roles with a valid purpose.
- Log authorized reveals without storing the revealed value.
- Ensure masked values are not exposed in page source or client-side logs.

## Done when
- Sensitive mobile fields are masked by default.
- Only authorized roles can reveal the full value.
- Reveal actions appear in the audit trail without recording the number.

## Dependencies
- SEC-2 role-scoped student data.
- PRV-6 sensitive-data audit trail.

## Size
S

issues.title: DSH-1: Build role-specific dashboards
issues.body:
## Goal
Show each staff role only the information and tasks needed for its work.

## Work
- Admin: school summary, collection and today's attendance.
- Teacher: assigned classes, attendance not yet marked and marks pending.
- Clerk: collected today and overdue fees.
- Enforce access in API responses as well as the UI.
- Use real database/API values only; show empty states when no data exists.

## Done when
- Each role lands on its own dashboard.
- No role sees data outside its permissions.
- Figures match underlying authorized API data.
- Empty datasets never produce demo numbers.

## Dependencies
- SEC-2 role-scoped student data.
- SEC-3 fee-data restrictions.

## Size
L

issues.title: DSH-2: Remove fabricated dashboard numbers and notifications
issues.body:
## Goal
Ensure every dashboard count, badge and notification represents real application data.

## Work
- Remove the fixed unread-notification badge.
- Remove demo/fallback dashboard numbers.
- Replace empty values with clear empty states and next steps.
- Do not substitute fabricated values when an API request fails.

## Done when
- No fixed or demo count is displayed as real data.
- Empty states explain what the user can do next.
- API failures are shown as errors, not zero or sample values.

## Size
S

issues.title: DSH-3: Add today's attendance status panel
issues.body:
## Goal
Help teachers and administrators see which classes completed attendance today.

## Work
- Show attendance-marked and not-yet-marked classes for the current school day.
- Link each class to its attendance workflow.
- Respect teacher class assignments and admin permissions.
- Handle holidays, weekends and classes without enrolled students using school rules.

## Done when
- Status uses actual attendance records and school calendar rules.
- Teachers see only assigned classes.
- Admins can identify classes with pending attendance.
- Each item links to the relevant attendance screen.

## Dependencies
- SEC-2 role-scoped student data.

## Size
M

issues.title: DSH-4: Add accessible real-data dashboard charts
issues.body:
## Goal
Present attendance and fee trends accurately with an accessible alternative to charts.

## Work
- Add attendance trend and monthly collection charts using real API data.
- Provide a table with the same values for accessibility.
- Respect fee-data permissions.
- Support light/dark themes and responsive layouts.

## Done when
- Chart and table values match.
- No sample data is used.
- Teachers cannot retrieve fee chart data.
- Charts work on mobile and in both themes.

## Dependencies
- SEC-2 role-scoped student data.
- SEC-3 fee-data restrictions.

## Size
M

issues.title: TRN-1: Add transport route summary cards
issues.body:
## Goal
Make route and rider information easy for authorized staff to understand.

## Work
- Show route name, assigned driver, rider count and monthly fee summary.
- Open a route detail view with its authorized rider list.
- Calculate counts and totals from real records.
- Do not expose full student profiles in route summaries.

## Done when
- A clerk can find riders on a route quickly.
- Counts and totals match underlying records.
- Each role sees only permitted fields.

## Dependencies
- SEC-2 role-scoped student data.

## Size
M

issues.title: TRN-2: Separate Add Driver and Add Route workflows
issues.body:
## Goal
Ensure Add Route creates a route rather than opening the driver form.

## Work
- Provide separate Add Driver and Add Route actions.
- Give each its own form, validation and save flow.
- Connect a driver to a route through an explicit assignment step.
- Show clear success and error messages.

## Done when
- Add Driver opens only the driver form.
- Add Route opens only the route form.
- Both workflows validate and save the intended record.

## Size
S

issues.title: TRN-3: Create a driver view limited to the assigned route
issues.body:
## Goal
Give drivers only the minimum rider information needed for their own route.

## Work
- Show only the signed-in driver's assigned route.
- Limit rider fields to name, class, stop and guardian phone where approved.
- Enforce route scoping in backend queries and authorization.
- Prevent drivers from accessing other student pages or routes.

## Done when
- A driver cannot retrieve another route's riders by changing a URL or API parameter.
- Only approved rider fields are returned.
- Automated tests cover driver access boundaries.

## Dependencies
- SEC-2 role-scoped student data.

## Size
M

issues.title: TRN-4: Add student-to-route assignment workflow
issues.body:
## Goal
Allow authorized staff to assign or move a student to a transport route with clear fee impact.

## Work
- Support route assignment from student details and route details.
- Validate route and stop selections.
- Show applicable fee changes before saving.
- Update route rider counts and fee summaries from saved records.
- Record assignment changes for auditability.

## Done when
- Authorized staff can assign and move students between routes.
- Fee impact is visible before confirmation.
- Route counts and fee summaries update from real data.

## Dependencies
- SEC-2 role-scoped student data.
- Confirm existing fee rules before changing calculations.

## Size
M

issues.title: TRN-5: Decide whether GEA should collect live bus location
issues.body:
## Goal
Make an explicit privacy and safety decision before adding live transport tracking.

## Work
- Document whether live location tracking is needed.
- If proposed, define child-safety purpose, authorized viewers, guardian notice, retention and access controls.
- Do not collect location until the school approves the decision and privacy review.
- Prefer no tracking if a clear need and safeguards cannot be established.

## Done when
- A written school decision is recorded.
- No live location is collected before approval.
- If approved, a separate implementation issue defines safeguards and tests.

## Dependencies
- PRV-1 data inventory.
- PRV-2 privacy notice and school review.

## Size
S

issues.title: RPT-1: Create a unified role-aware reports index
issues.body:
## Goal
Provide named, consistent school reports with safe filtering, printing and CSV export.

## Work
- Add reports for class list, attendance register, marks sheet, fee dues and route list.
- Provide relevant filters for each report.
- Add Print and CSV actions where permitted.
- Remove the full-profile students-by-driver report.
- Document columns and allowed roles for every report.

## Done when
- Each report lists its purpose, columns and permitted roles.
- Reports return only required fields.
- Print and CSV actions respect authorization and export safeguards.

## Dependencies
- SEC-2 role-scoped student data.
- SEC-3 fee-data restrictions.
- PRV-8 export and print safeguards.

## Size
L

issues.title: RPT-2: Make Reports and Charts consistent and responsive
issues.body:
## Goal
Give Reports and Charts the same visual quality and responsive behavior as Analytics.

## Work
- Align layout, typography, spacing and controls with the shared design system.
- Format currency consistently in Indian rupees.
- Add clear page titles and light/dark theme support.
- Fix tables, filters and actions for narrow phone widths.

## Done when
- Reports and Charts pass a 360px viewport check.
- Both themes are usable.
- Currency and page titles are consistent.
- Visual changes do not alter data or permissions behavior.

## Dependencies
- Shared design system from UX-6.

## Size
M

issues.title: RPT-3: Enforce report access by staff role
issues.body:
## Goal
Ensure each staff role can access only the reports needed for its duties.

## Work
- Teachers: academic reports only.
- Clerks: fee reports only.
- Admins: all approved reports.
- Enforce role restrictions in API endpoints and navigation.
- Add positive and negative tests for each role.

## Done when
- Teachers cannot retrieve fee reports.
- Clerks cannot retrieve restricted academic reports.
- Admins can access all approved reports.
- Tests verify allowed and denied access.

## Dependencies
- SEC-2 role-scoped student data.
- SEC-3 fee-data restrictions.

## Size
S

issues.title: RPT-4: Consolidate charts into the pages where they are used
issues.body:
## Goal
Reduce duplicate navigation and keep each chart beside the workflow it explains.

## Work
- Identify charts used by Analytics and Collection.
- Move useful charts into their relevant pages.
- Retire the standalone Charts page only if it adds no unique value.
- Provide a table alternative for every retained chart.

## Done when
- Every retained chart has a clear home and matching table.
- No chart with unique required information is removed.
- Role permissions remain enforced.

## Dependencies
- DSH-4 real-data chart patterns.
- SEC-3 fee-data restrictions.

## Size
M

issues.title: UX-1: Add role-aware navigation and mobile task bar
issues.body:
## Goal
Make navigation simpler and show staff only areas they can use.

## Work
- Group navigation into Daily Work, Reports and Admin.
- Show only pages available to the signed-in role.
- Add a mobile bottom bar for the four most-used tasks based on school workflows.
- Keep direct URL and API authorization independent of navigation.

## Done when
- Users do not see links for unavailable modules.
- The mobile task bar works at phone widths.
- Keyboard and desktop navigation remain usable.
- Hiding a link never substitutes for backend authorization.

## Dependencies
- SEC-2 role-scoped student data.
- SEC-3 fee-data restrictions.

## Size
M

issues.title: UX-2: Improve bilingual sign-in experience
issues.body:
## Goal
Make sign-in understandable and accessible without exposing development-only controls.

## Work
- Add clear authentication error messages.
- Add a show/hide password control.
- Remember the username only with explicit user choice and school approval.
- Support Hindi and English.
- Remove login-bypass hints and developer-only text from production UI.

## Done when
- Wrong credentials produce a clear, non-revealing message.
- Password visibility can be toggled.
- Hindi and English sign-in labels are available.
- No bypass or developer hint appears in production.

## Dependencies
- SEC-6 production safety checks.
- SEC-8 login hardening.
- UX-3 translations.

## Size
M

issues.title: UX-3: Add complete Hindi and English translations
issues.body:
## Goal
Provide consistent bilingual labels and messages throughout the application.

## Work
- Move user-facing strings into a shared translation resource.
- Cover pages, validation messages, notifications and empty/error states.
- Use a suitable Devanagari font.
- Test long Hindi and English labels to prevent clipping.

## Done when
- Switching language updates all covered pages and messages.
- No user-facing hard-coded strings remain in covered screens.
- Long labels remain readable on mobile and desktop.

## Dependencies
- Shared design system from UX-6.

## Size
L

issues.title: UX-4: Standardize loading, empty, error and saved states
issues.body:
## Goal
Make application feedback consistent across every module.

## Work
- Define shared patterns for loading, empty, error-with-retry and saved states.
- Apply them to Students, Dashboard, Attendance, Fees, Exams, Transport, Reports and Settings.
- Ensure errors are distinct from empty data.
- Provide accessible status announcements.

## Done when
- Covered pages use the same state patterns and language.
- Failed requests are not shown as empty or successful.
- Retry actions work where appropriate.
- Status messages are accessible.

## Size
M

issues.title: UX-5: Support safe draft recovery on poor networks
issues.body:
## Goal
Prevent staff from losing attendance and marks entry when connectivity is interrupted.

## Work
- Define which forms may save a local draft and how drafts are protected.
- Support retrying a failed save.
- Clearly distinguish saved, pending and unsaved changes.
- Prevent duplicate submissions when retrying.
- Avoid storing unnecessary student data in browser storage.

## Done when
- A network interruption does not silently discard in-progress entries.
- The UI clearly says when data is not saved.
- Retrying does not create duplicate records.
- Draft storage follows the approved privacy/security design.

## Dependencies
- SEC-4 session/authentication design.
- PRV-1 data inventory and retention review.

## Size
L

issues.title: UX-6: Build a shared SCSS design system and remove obsolete styles
issues.body:
## Goal
Create one maintainable visual foundation for all GEA pages.

## Work
- Define shared color, spacing, typography, radius and component tokens in SCSS.
- Provide reusable styles for buttons, forms, cards, tables, dialogs and navigation.
- Replace page-specific inline styling where practical.
- Remove obsolete debug files and unused CSS only after confirming no page depends on them.
- Coordinate stylesheet cleanup with strict CSP work.

## Done when
- New and updated pages use shared design tokens and components.
- Inline styling is removed from the agreed CSP scope.
- No active page relies on deleted styles.
- Light and dark themes remain consistent.

## Dependencies
- Coordinate with SEC-5 strict frontend content security policy.

## Size
L

issues.title: UX-7: Decide whether to keep the AI Chat page
issues.body:
## Goal
Make a documented product and privacy decision about AI Chat before further investment.

## Work
- Ask the school whether AI Chat is needed and for which staff roles.
- If removed, remove navigation and disable entry points without breaking unrelated features.
- If retained, add a limitation notice, role-based starter prompts and safeguards against entering personal student data.
- Keep the feature disabled until the privacy decision and safeguards are approved.

## Done when
- The school decision is documented.
- AI Chat is safely disabled/removed or has an approved scope and safeguards.
- Personal student data is not encouraged in prompts.

## Dependencies
- PRV-9 AI chat personal-data limits.
- PRV-3 consent/legal review where applicable.

## Size
S

issues.title: UX-8: Complete accessibility checks across remaining pages
issues.body:
## Goal
Bring the remaining GEA screens up to a consistent accessibility baseline.

## Work
- Check labels, keyboard focus, contrast, headings and status messages.
- Cover Students, Dashboard, Transport, Reports, Charts, Attendance and Marks.
- Fix keyboard traps and controls without accessible names.
- Test representative phone and desktop layouts.

## Done when
- All listed pages pass the agreed accessibility checklist.
- Forms and controls have programmatic labels.
- Keyboard focus is visible and logical.
- Status and validation messages are announced accessibly.

## Dependencies
- Shared components from UX-6.
- UX-4 shared state patterns.

## Size
M
